_comment: Mutation testing for the code that decides what merges without a human (README 'Mutation testing'). command runner: Stryker has no Playwright Test runner, so every mutant re-runs only the specs that import the mutated modules. --retries=0: CI config retries twice, and Playwright exits 0 on flaky-passed-on-retry, which would count an intermittently failing mutant as Survived. timeoutMS 30000: with the default (~7s, derived from a 1.4s dry run) Playwright startup under 5 parallel runners timed out on 56 of 62 verify-stability mutants, and Stryker counts a timeout as killed - the first baseline read 85.9% when the real score was 71.1%.

commandRunner.command: npx playwright test --project=unit --retries=0 --reporter=dot -x tests/unit/safety-gates.spec.ts tests/unit/verify-stability.spec.ts tests/unit/pr-reviewer.spec.ts
